versions.content: Purpose of AtpStructureElement A structure element is a feature which is also a classifier and hence specifies its own structure instead of refer- encing to a type. 155 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 The abstract class for this kind of element is AtpStructureElement . Structure el- ements are simpler to define because a single element does the job of both type and prototype.
